subject: Harbor Health MAP: deployment mode, region selection, and close timeline
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@harborhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@harborhealth.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Harbor Health MAP draft — deployment mode & region questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our working MAP (see tab 'Scope & Milestones') — we pulled together a high-level set of objectives and a hard deadline driven by an internal product launch on 2026-07-15.

Two things blocking our ability to sign:
- Decision on deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — we need to balance time-to-launch vs PHI compliance.
- Region selection / data residency rules for a subset of patient data (some states require in-region storage).

Can Redwood propose an evaluation plan (duration, success criteria) that would let us make a firm decision by 2026-06-28? We'd prefer to avoid a multi-month procurement delay but also need a clear path if we must go private.

Also looping in Raj (IT) for any baseline security / network questions.

Appreciate a short plan and recommended next steps.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Product — Clinical Services
Harbor Health

[Attachment: HarborHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harbor Health MAP draft — deployment mode & region questions

Emily — thanks for the MAP and context. High level response below; see inline asks and a proposed 2-week evaluation plan.

Quick recommendation (short):
- Short-term path to meet your 2026-07-15 launch: Hosted (Redwood API) as primary, with a Dedicated procurement track started in parallel if PHI/data residency forces isolation. This lets you ship features quickly while keeping the option to migrate with a versioning/rollout plan.

Proposed evaluation plan (2 weeks):
1) Week 1 (config & smoke): enable a hosted sandbox in US-West, run representative traffic (we'll provide a traffic generator). Success criteria: latency p50 < 120ms for 1–2k qps equivalent in smoke tests; key prompts pass quality baselines (f1 > 0.85 on your eval set).
2) Week 2 (security & governance): run the security questionnaire, validate KMS integration options, and test region/geofence rules against a small data set. Success: SOC2 evidence reviewed; acceptable KMS flow documented.

If Week 2 uncovers hard regulatory blockers (state geofence or legal mandate requiring customer-managed infra), we pivot to Dedicated or Private. We'll provide a migration checklist and an estimated 6–8 week Dedicated onboarding (procurement dependent).

Asks from Redwood to make the eval deterministic:
- Can Harbor provide the 50 canonical prompts for the eval by EOD Tue 2026-06-16?
- Any specific states / datasets that must be geofenced? A short list of tables/types is fine.
- Primary contact for procurement questions so we can share the Dedicated SOW template.

Attachments: I attached a short 'Eval Playbook' and the MAP with our proposed milestones inline.

Next steps: proposed call Fri 06/12 10:00am PT to confirm prompts and scope. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment: Redwood_EvalPlaybook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@harborhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harbor Health MAP draft — deployment mode & region questions

Adding a technical note on the Hosted -> Dedicated migration path and timeline so the team has realistic expectations:

- Hosted (fastest): we can stand up a production-hosted route in US-West within 3 business days post-PO; supports streaming, function-calling, KV caching. Good for feature velocity and lower upfront cost.
- Dedicated (predictable & isolated): Requires GPU pool reservation and network setup (VPC peering or private endpoints). Typical onboarding: 6 weeks after contract signature (includes infra provisioning, benchmark tuning, and canary config).
- Private (on-prem): 10–14 weeks depending on your infra readiness; recommended only if legal/regulatory mandates prohibit cloud.

Canary strategy suggestion if you start Hosted now:
- Week 0–2: Hosted sandbox + synthetic load + eval prompts.
- Week 3–4: Live canary (5–10% traffic) routed to Hosted with auto-fallback to lower-cost model if latency spikes.
- Week 5+: If Dedicated procurement completes, cutover in a controlled A/B rollout (traffic shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2–3 days).

I'll also prepare a short note on quantization / model-size tradeoffs for Dedicated (helps procurement estimate GPU type).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Onboarding_Timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Emily Zhang <emily@harborhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@harborhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Harbor Health MAP draft — deployment mode & region questions

Thanks — this is really helpful and aligned with our timeline constraints. Quick decisions from Harbor:

- We will proceed with the Hosted path for the initial launch (targeting 2026-07-15) to avoid blocking product release.
- Procurement will run in parallel to evaluate Dedicated for PHI workloads; if Dedicated is required we'll aim for an active cutover no later than 2026-09-01.
- Raj confirms the list of geofenced datasets (see short list below). IT will validate KMS options with Redwood next week.

Short list of geofence items (from Raj):
- PHI_patient_records (subset of tables)
- Imaging meta (dicom pointers only)
- State-level consent flags

Emily's asks / acceptance criteria for the MAP:
- We accept the 2-week Eval Playbook as the initial MAP milestone; please treat the eval as gating for final signature.
- Request Redwood to provide a Hosted runbook for rollback/fallback and a Dedicated SOW draft by 2026-06-18.

Call confirmed: Fri 06/12 10:00am PT (Emily, Raj, Olga, Karthik) — moving to calendar.

Attaching Harbor's completed security questionnaire; we'll send any follow-up items after Redwood's review.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Product — Clinical Services
Harbor Health

[Attachment: HarborHealth_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]
